title: Functions
description: Learn to write reusable code blocks.

sections.title: What is a Function?
sections.markdown: A function is a block of code which only runs when it is called. You can pass data into a function.
key_points: What is a Function? is a core concept to understand
Practice applying What in real code

sections.title: Defining and Calling
sections.markdown: Use the def keyword to create a function, and parenthesis to call it.
key_points: Defining and Calling is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Defining in real code

sections.title: Parameters and Arguments
sections.markdown: Parameters are defined in the signature; arguments are the actual values passed.
key_points: Parameters and Arguments is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Parameters in real code

sections.title: Return Values
sections.markdown: Use the return statement to send data back to the caller.
key_points: Return Values is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Return in real code

sections.title: Default Arguments
sections.markdown: You can assign default values to parameters. Warning: avoid mutable defaults like lists.
key_points: Default Arguments is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Default in real code

sections.title: Keyword Arguments
sections.markdown: You can send arguments with the key=value syntax, ignoring order.
key_points: Keyword Arguments is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Keyword in real code

sections.title: Args and Kwargs
sections.markdown: Use *args for variable positional arguments, and **kwargs for variable keyword arguments.
key_points: Args and Kwargs is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Args in real code

sections.title: Scope and LEGB
sections.markdown: Variable scope follows the LEGB rule: Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in.
key_points: Scope and LEGB is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Scope in real code

sections.title: Pure Functions
sections.markdown: Pure functions always produce the same output for the same input and have no side effects.
key_points: Pure Functions is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Pure in real code

sections.title: Lambda
sections.markdown: Small anonymous functions defined with the lambda keyword.
key_points: Lambda is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Lambda in real code

sections.title: First-Class Functions
sections.markdown: Functions can be passed as arguments or returned from other functions.
key_points: First-Class Functions is a core concept to understand
Practice applying First-Class in real code

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.markdown: Mutable default arguments are the most common pitfall.
key_points: Common Mistakes is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Common in real code

sections.title: Interview Points
sections.markdown: Expect questions on decorators or closure scope.
key_points: Interview Points is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interview in real code

summary: Master the function definition syntax. *args collects positional arguments into a tuple; **kwargs collects keyword arguments into a dict. Understanding args kwargs is essential for flexible APIs and decorators.
interview_takeaways: The function definition uses def, followed by name and parameters. Use *args and **kwargs to accept variable positional and keyword arguments respectively.
